const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /Users/dhruv2mars/dev/github/portfolio/gauntlet/critics/color-atmosphere-r2.md
+piece: color-atmosphere
+round: r2
+winner: bar
+biggest_gap: R2 dark finally has visible warm ink depth—grid, grain, vignette—but it still reads as cyan-brand-on-amber-wash: the avatar and nav mark are the loudest hue, so amber never becomes the promised singular signal. The grid is wallpaper-like rather than authored atmosphere. Worse, light-home-desktop.png is only a blank warm paper/grid field: no mark, nav, type, or content. That is a total light-theme craft/parity failure, and a regression from r1. Bar fields (dai blueprint, pham ASCII, eftakher frame, ericsin light grid) stay legible, specific, and complete.
+next_build_instruction: Fix capture/theme rendering before tuning polish: recapture light at settled state and hard-assert hero/nav pixels exist. Then remove cyan from avatar, nav, and controls or retint them to the amber contract; reserve #e8a23a/#c47e1a for one readable signal. Replace generic full-field grid with one identity-tied structural layer (frame, plane, or watermark), keep grain/vignette subordinate, and verify dark/light desktop plus mobile show the same complete composition at contrast parity.
+evidence_paths:
+  - gauntlet/pieces/color-atmosphere/r2/dark-home-desktop.png
